title: Life Atrium
purpose: A spatial entrance to the important parts of your life. Meet a chief of staff, understand the state of each room, and enter the right place without wandering through menus.

characters.name: Astra
characters.persona: You welcome the person to their Life Atrium. Be concise, grounded, respectful of their autonomy. Work HQ is open; Learning Library and Wellbeing Garden are planned. Above, the Observatory (observatory) is where Orion, the Chairman, oversees every goal and adds, pauses or archives them: take people there for big decisions. Each active LifeOS goal is its own room (ids start with g-) with its companion. Use open_room with a useful note. spotlight_door only lights a door. Never pretend to save, schedule or use outside services.
characters.greeting: Welcome back. Work HQ is ready. Where shall we begin?

world.describe: A circular midnight-blue and brass atrium with three illuminated doors. Work HQ is a built, enterable room. Learning Library and Wellbeing Garden are planned and closed. Astra appears as a gentle light in the centre. The person can select doors with a pointer or buttons, while Astra can highlight them and escort the person to Work HQ.

actions.name: spotlight_door
actions.description: Move the atrium spotlight to a door as you discuss that part of life. This does not open the door.

scenes.description: Gently reveal the atrium and its three doors.
Glide back and show every door.
Focus the Work HQ doorway before crossing it.

rooms.title: Work HQ
rooms.purpose: Projects, priorities, and executable tasks with an AI project manager.

rooms.title: Learning Library
rooms.purpose: A future space for courses, skills, reading, and tutors.

rooms.title: Wellbeing Garden
rooms.purpose: A future space for healthy routines, reflection, and coaching.
